fieldGuidance.secureImportReviewStatus: Use adult_approved_for_secure_extension_import only after the word is approved for live secure-extension import. Use rejected_needs_source_revision when it must not ship.
fieldGuidance.acceptedSpellings: Pipe-separated spellings accepted by the marker. Include the canonical word when approved.
fieldGuidance.rejectedVariants: Pipe-separated common confusions or variants that must not be accepted, where useful.
fieldGuidance.explanation: One child-safe KS2 explanation of the word or spelling point.
fieldGuidance.exampleSentence1: A KS2-suitable sentence using the word naturally.
fieldGuidance.ukSpellingDecision: Explicit UK spelling policy decision, including whether US variants are rejected or absent.
fieldGuidance.patternTags: Pipe-separated spelling pattern tags, if applicable.
fieldGuidance.familyRoot: Word family/root relation used for grouping and teaching.
fieldGuidance.safetyNotes: Safety, exclusion, age-suitability, or advisory-resolution notes.
fieldGuidance.audioStatus: Audio requirement or availability status, for example tts_required, audio_available, or not_required.
fieldGuidance.ttsStatus: TTS plan/status, for example planned, verified, not_required, or blocked.
fieldGuidance.secureImportApprovalDecision: Use APPROVED_FOR_SECURE_EXTENSION_IMPORT only when the row is approved for live secure-extension import.

safety.purpose: Data collection template for a future release-approved secure-extension source artefact.
